verdict.rationale: The pack contains no first-party evidence that recruiters can add custom questions, set knockout or disqualifying rules, or collect EEOC/demographic data compliantly in Workable's application forms. The 'Custom application form' item only describes keeping your own website form and pushing candidates in through the API, which is a developer workaround. The careers-page auto-fill and application translation items are adjacent features, not form customization.

support.subject: As a recruiter, application forms are mine to shape — custom questions, knockout rules, and EEOC/demographic collection handled compliantly
